title: Certify rank-seven scalar grids and 77-bit endpoint formats
body:
## Summary

Close the formal scalar-grid part of PR3080's caller-format handoff. For independent signed 64-bit atoms in both PR3076 providers, the exact common grid needs four fractional guard bits forward and five dual; both streams need 77 signed endpoint bits at their least common grid.

```text
reconstruct pinned words and fresh emitted programs
  replay every prefix over reduced free-warp atoms
  compare Fraction rows with separate fixed-denominator integer rows
  prove ADD divisibility and execute extremal literal bit circuits
```

Adds only `research/rank7-coefficient-grid/`, with proof, exact sources, deterministic evidence and registered reproduction. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18984043). Credit PR3080/3076/3078/3060/3056, dcharb78/PR3042, Jeremy Kothe, Marius-Paul Dumitrean, Cinna Davis, icekylinx, Tekalign and the retained native/owner lineage.

## Evidence

- Before: a cancellation-blind control implemented here gives 195/202 sufficient bits. After: exact reduced-word analysis gives 77, with row norms 302/169 and attaining D-1/W-1 rejection fixtures. The control is an analysis comparison, not an upstream physical allocation.
- Both engines agree on all four streams, including every prefix-ledger digest. They cover 17,635 changed rows per stream and all 632 dirty columns; smaller grids fail at actual fractional operations. Literal 77-bit ADDs preserve sources and return carries.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, thirteen normal/optimized behavioral groups, warning-as-error execution, Ruff, internal read-only review and all 35 committed-file byte comparisons pass locally. Hosted CI is separate.
- Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-coefficient-grid`. The README gives external-output commands, source pins and open next questions.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

This is a finite formal coefficient-stream certificate. Native adapters, climbs and centre transforms are explicitly omitted from this scalar model; their physical grid/range interpretation, internal arithmetic, source routing, clean carry backing and complete storage/execution invoice remain open. Signed phases use the symmetric norm bound, not the asymmetric atom extrema. No paid profile, supplier, selected frontier or kappa change is claimed. PR3081's local half-ADD caller and PR3079's profile audit remain distinct.
